Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>visible</p><div style="display:none">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(hidden_content: 'Reachable'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
